units.source_text: 冷泉帝既已发心为源氏祝寿，不肯就此作罢，

en.t: Once Emperor Reizei had resolved to celebrate Genji's birthday, he would not let the matter end there,

units.source_text: 便叮嘱中纳言夕雾，叫他出面主办。

en.t: and so he instructed the Middle Counselor Yugiri to come forward and take charge of the arrangements.

units.source_text: 这时候右大将因病辞职。

en.t: At this time the Right Captain-General resigned because of illness.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝为欲使这寿宴添喜，突然晋封夕雾为右大将。

en.t: Wanting to add further joy to the birthday banquet, Emperor Reizei suddenly promoted Yugiri to Right Captain-General.

units.source_text: 源氏闻之甚喜，但也表示谦逊，

en.t: Genji was greatly pleased when he heard this, but he also showed humility,

units.source_text: 他说：“如此突然晋升，荣幸实已过分，我觉得太早了。”

en.t: saying, "Such a sudden promotion is truly more honor than we deserve; I feel it is too soon."

units.source_text: 夕雾便在他的继母花散里所居东北院中安排寿宴。

en.t: Yugiri then arranged the birthday banquet in the northeast residence where his stepmother Hanachirusato lived.

units.source_text: 虽说是家宴，但今日乃奉圣旨，故仪式特别隆重。

en.t: Although it was called a family banquet, it was being held by imperial command that day, so the ceremony was especially solemn and grand.

units.source_text: 各处飨宴，皆由宫中内藏寮及谷仓院办理。

en.t: The banquets in every place were all managed by the palace Bureau of Storehouses and the Granary Office.

units.source_text: 屯食仿照宫中式样，由头中将奉旨办理。

en.t: The prepared provisions followed palace style and were handled by the Head Captain by imperial order.

units.source_text: 参与庆祝的有亲王五人，左右大臣、大纳言二人，中纳言三人，参议五人，

en.t: Those taking part in the celebration included five princes, the ministers of the left and right, two senior counselors, three middle counselors, and five councillors,

units.source_text: 殿上人照例有冷泉帝身边的、皇太子身边的和朱雀院身边的，不参与者绝少。

en.t: and among the courtiers, as usual, there were men attached to Emperor Reizei, to the Crown Prince, and to the Suzaku Cloistered Emperor; very few failed to attend.

units.source_text: 源氏的座位及用品，均由冷泉帝详细吩咐太政大臣置办。

en.t: Genji's seat and all the articles he would use were prepared by the Grand Minister under Emperor Reizei's detailed instructions.

units.source_text: 太政大臣本人亦奉旨参与庆祝。

en.t: The Grand Minister himself also joined the celebration by imperial command.

units.source_text: 源氏诚惶诚恐地就座受贺。

en.t: Genji took his seat with reverent apprehension and received the congratulations.

units.source_text: 太政大臣的座位与正屋中源氏的座位相对。

en.t: The Grand Minister's seat faced Genji's seat in the main room.

units.source_text: 这位太政大臣容貌清秀，身材魁伟，春秋鼎盛，具足富贵之相。

en.t: This Grand Minister had refined, handsome features, a splendid physique, and the full vigor of mature manhood, with every sign of wealth and rank.

units.source_text: 主人源氏则青春永驻，依然是昔年的源氏公子。

en.t: Their host Genji, meanwhile, seemed to keep eternal youth and was still the same Prince Genji of former days.

units.source_text: 屏风四叠，是皇上御笔，淡紫色中国绫子上的墨画，美妙不可言喻。

en.t: The four folding screens bore the Emperor's own brushwork: ink paintings on pale purple Chinese twill, beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 比较起漂亮的彩色春秋风景画来，

en.t: Even when compared with lovely colored landscapes of spring and autumn,

units.source_text: 这屏风上的墨色光彩逼人，不可同日而语。

en.t: the radiant ink tones on these screens were so striking that the two could not be spoken of in the same breath.

units.source_text: 想起了皇上御笔，自然更觉可贵。

en.t: Remembering that they were painted by the Emperor's own hand naturally made them seem all the more precious.

units.source_text: 盛装饰物的柜子、弦乐器、管乐器等，皆由宫中藏人所供应。

en.t: The cabinets for ornamental objects, the stringed instruments, the wind instruments, and the like were all supplied by the palace chamberlains.
